matrix.tone_rationale: Motivational language to drive trial engagement and encourage users to take action.
Informative language to educate users on the benefits of paid subscription, while using a mild sense of urgency to encourage renewal.
Loss avoidance language to re-engage churned users, while using social influence to encourage them to try again.
Unpredictability language to surprise inactive users and encourage them to try again, while using social influence to make the experience more engaging.
